Devices.lanSetupTitle: Office LAN setup: use the Sync Agent
Devices.lanSetupDesc: Most biometric devices use private IP addresses like 192.168.x.x, so the cloud server cannot reach them directly. Install the local Sync Agent on an office PC to send attendance to PeopleFlow. Direct Test/Sync/View Users only works when the device is reachable from the cloud via VPN or public routing.
Devices.step1Desc: Create a secure authentication key for your office sync agent.
Devices.step2Desc: Download the pre-configured sync agent script. It has your cloud URL and API key built in.
Devices.step3Desc: Open Command Prompt (Win) or Terminal (Mac) in the folder where you saved the file and run:
Devices.keyCopyWarning: Copy this key NOW! It will never be shown again.
Devices.noAgentsYet: No sync agents configured yet. Generate an API key to get started.
Devices.officeDeviceFlow: Office device → local Sync Agent → PeopleFlow Cloud
Devices.officeDeviceFlowDesc: Fingerprint devices usually use private office IPs like <ip>192.168.x.x</ip>. PeopleFlow Cloud cannot safely reach those directly. Install the Sync Agent on one office PC; it reads the LAN device and securely sends attendance to PeopleFlow.
Devices.guideStep1Desc: Save LAN IP/port from the office network.
Devices.guideStep2Desc: Generate key and download ready script.
Devices.guideStep3Desc: Verify cloud + device without pushing records.
Devices.guideStep4Desc: Link biometric IDs, then start live sync.
Devices.emptyGuidedDesc: Start by adding the office device IP/port. After that, use the guided Sync Agent setup so office staff can connect it to PeopleFlow Cloud without developer help.
Devices.advancedTestTooltip: Advanced: direct cloud test only works if this private LAN device is reachable from the server. For normal offices, use Sync Agent dry-run.
Devices.advancedSyncTooltip: Advanced: direct cloud sync only works with VPN/public routing. Normal offices should keep the local Sync Agent running.
Devices.agentSetupSubtitle: Connect LAN-only ZKTeco devices to PeopleFlow Cloud without VPN, public IP, or developer support.
Devices.agentOfficeLanDesc: Fingerprint devices usually live inside the office network using private IPs like <ip>192.168.x.x</ip>. PeopleFlow Cloud should not try to directly enter that office LAN. Instead, a small Sync Agent runs on one office PC and securely pushes attendance to the cloud.
Devices.needOfficePc: One PC kept on during office hours
Devices.agentOnlineDesc: Online means the office PC is running the agent and talking to PeopleFlow Cloud.
Devices.noOfficeAgentDesc: Start with Step 1 below. The first key creates the downloadable agent.
Devices.wizardSafetyDesc: Follow left to right. Do not start live sync before dry-run and employee mapping.
Devices.agentStep1Desc: One key per office PC. If a PC changes, revoke the old key and create a new one.
Devices.agentStep2Desc: The file already contains this cloud URL and key. Staff do not need to configure the server.
Devices.agentStep3Desc: Dry-run checks cloud + device + latest attendance without pushing anything.
Devices.agentStep4Desc: Link device user IDs with employees before live sync to avoid unmapped attendance.

Statutory.title: Statutory Registers — BLA 2006
Statutory.subtitle: Form A–K labour registers mandated by the Bangladesh Labour Act 2006
Statutory.noData: No records found for this period.
Statutory.bannerBody: These eleven registers must be available for inspection on demand. Generate them on or before the first visit of a labour inspector — absence is a stop-production issue under the Bangladesh Labour Act 2006.
Statutory.formADesc: Establishment particulars: name, address, nature of work, employee strength.
Statutory.formBDesc: Every worker with employee code, joining date, employment type and current status.
Statutory.formCDesc: Monthly wage payments — gross earnings, deductions and net pay per SalarySlip.
Statutory.formDDesc: Fines and punitive deductions levied on workers — amount, cause, date.
Statutory.formEDesc: Salary advances and loans disbursed — principal, EMI, balance outstanding.
Statutory.formFDesc: Overtime hours worked and OT pay at double the basic rate.
Statutory.formGDesc: Leave applications — type, from/to dates, duration, approval status.
Statutory.formHDesc: Maternity leave records — pre/post delivery split, 16-week entitlement tracking.
Statutory.formIDesc: Daily attendance of every worker — present/absent/late/half-day status.
Statutory.formJDesc: Labour inspector visits — date, inspector name, observations, follow-up actions.
Statutory.formKDesc: Display notice — summary of working hours, wages, leave and benefits applicable.
